answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. Consequently, an attacker with a large flock pays more to keep it alive than it can ever extract, which is why Sybil campaigns fail here.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a river as the anchor of the cost.
